title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-mjcp: fragments_in_window_vec parity filter fragile for >2 windows
description:
## Issue

`FragmentSender::fragments_in_window_vec(abs_window)` at fragment.rs:1013-1014 uses parity-only filtering:
```rust
self.iter().filter(|f| f.window == (abs_window % 2) as u8).collect()
```

`get_fragment` sets `window = index / WINDOW_SIZE` (absolute window number, can be 0, 1, 2, ...). The parity filter `abs_window % 2` would match fragments from window 0 AND window 2 when asked for abs_window=2 (both parity 0), returning wrong tiles.

## Current impact: none

With `MAX_PACKET_SIZE=16384`, `TILE_SIZE=187`, `WINDOW_SIZE=63`, the max tile count = ceil(16384/187) = 88, producing at most 2 windows. Parity uniquely identifies the window. But this is fragile.

## Fix

Change filter to exact absolute window match:
```rust
self.iter().filter(|f| f.window == abs_window as u8).collect()
```

Note: this may require changes to `write_to` which rejects `fragment.window > 1`. The sender-retransmit path would need to wrap absolute window to parity before wire encoding.
